source: NFL-SPS three-sort board — ADP / Win-Now / Dynasty(preview) | STAGED cross-pos dynasty recal (proposal) | FINAL skill 2025 refresh + K=8 shrinkage WR/TE-only (RB raw carve-out) | STAGED win-now v2 (proposal): skill from signed-off full-roster projection + cross-pos calibration; QB ratified tempered-stacked | STAGED win-now v3 (proposal): v2 scale held; rookie QBs mapped onto veteran tempered-stacked value scale; deep-bench nulls floored at positional replacement level
scale_note: val is on the shared dynasty scale used by the college board (0-~103, #1 college asset = ~103); values are directly comparable across leagues.
cross_league_caveat: Cross-league comparisons (college devy assets vs. NFL players) should be read as an approximate tier comparison, not an exact point-for-point match. Lining a college prospect up against a pro player carries real uncertainty, so treat a close cross-league verdict as a coarse tier read and let roster fit and timeline break the tie.

board_format.settings: superflex · TEP · full PPR · 6-pt passing TD
board_format.value_note: adp: lower is earlier/better (null = unranked). win_now & dynasty: higher is better, on the shared value scale. val = leveling currency (unchanged).

dynasty_recal.method: per-position exchange rate q_pos (superflex+TEP startup ADP); within-pos order preserved exactly

qb_respread.reason: flat QB scalar 0.46 crushed compressed QB1; respread onto market QB shape, QB1 anchored 101
qb_respread.form: order-preserving rank->value map of model QBs onto the market QB value shape mkt=TV(adp) [double-exp startup-ADP curve], sorted descending, then scaled by a single anchor constant so QB1(Maye)==101; model QBs beyond the ~30 market QBs continue with geometric decay 0.93.

youth_temper.knob: age-tilt slope k (single lever); mean-preserving within position
youth_temper.effect: shrinks youth remaining-career runway advantage a hair; young ease down, proven vets tick up

skill_2025_FINAL.RB_carve_out: RB left RAW (Backtesting gate: shrink hurts RB OOS)
skill_2025_FINAL.QB_values: UNCHANGED (held byte-for-byte from prior staged feed)

winnow_v2.method: new_wn = q_pos * raw; one positive scalar/pos -> within-position order preserved exactly
winnow_v2.market: data/market/adp_ppr_redraft_2026.csv (1QB redraft; QB & TE policy-lifted for superflex+TEP)

winnow_v3.basis: inherits v2 win_now for all covered players (byte-identical); closes rookie-QB + deep-bench nulls

rookie_qb_map.method: value_rk = b0 * proj_2026_ppr_total; through-origin fit on 62 veteran QBs (proj -> tempered-stacked value)

replacement_floor.rule: floor[pos] = 0.5 * min(win_now among projection-covered players at pos)

tep_toggle.method: TE value(tep) = live_value + (tep-0.5) * proj_receptions * 0.27 (shared 0-103 dynasty-scale TE production exchange rate). Only TE dynasty/win_now shift; live=+0.5 baseline byte-unchanged.

inseason_refresh.method: val x (blended PPG / prior PPG)^beta_pos; blend = (3*prior + g*2026 PPG)/(3+g); full PPR, 6-pt pass TD
inseason_refresh.note: Only `val`, `rank`, `posrank` are refreshed. Sub-fields (dynasty, win_now, adp, ...) are the preseason values.
